corrected_fields.summary: Itron, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 24, 2026 disclosing that an unauthorized third party gained access to certain corporate systems on April 13, 2026. The company activated its cybersecurity response plan, notified law enforcement, and took remediation actions. No unauthorized activity was observed in customer-hosted systems, and operations have continued in all material respects. The company does not currently believe the incident has had or is reasonably likely to have a material impact.
